name: Oops, a Cannibal Got Your Nose!
source:
Who could have known? Turns out your bestie is a cannibal! He sure looked so well adjusted. 

Oh no, why do his eyes look so hungry? He's out for your nose!

Play as an unfortunate meal in this visual novel horror- survival adventure game! Make your choices wisely.  A wrong choice always steals a bit of your soul (and body). Can you escape?

[From [url=https://alexp-gaming.itch.io/a-cannibal-got-your-nose]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
谁会知道呢？原来你的闺蜜是个食人者！他看起来确实调整得很好。

哦不，为什么他的眼睛看起来那么饥饿？他是冲着你鼻子来的！

在这款视觉小说恐怖生存冒险游戏中扮演不幸的一餐！明智地做出选择。错误的选择总是会偷走你的一些灵魂（和身体）。你能逃脱吗？

[来自[url=https://alexp-gaming.itch.io/a-cannibal-got-your-nose]itch.io[/url]]
